# Mold Roster

> Mold Roster is a free directory of state-licensed mold assessors and remediators in Texas, Florida, New York and Washington DC, built from official licence records.

Mold Roster is for homeowners, tenants, landlords, buyers and insurance claimants who need a licensed mold assessor (inspection/testing) or remediator (removal). Listings come from TDLR (TX), DBPR (FL), NYS DOL (NY) and DOEE (DC) records retrieved 2026-10-12. A listing is not an endorsement. Every page has a Markdown version: replace the trailing slash with `.md` (home: https://moldroster.com/index.md).

## States
- [Texas](https://moldroster.com/tx/): Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation licence records
- [Florida](https://moldroster.com/fl/): Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation licence records
- [New York](https://moldroster.com/ny/): New York State Department of Labor licence records
- [Washington, DC](https://moldroster.com/dc/): DC Department of Energy & Environment licence records

## Guides
- [Mold assessment vs remediation](https://moldroster.com/mold-assessment-vs-remediation/)
- [Mold inspection & remediation cost + estimate tool](https://moldroster.com/mold-remediation-cost/)
- [Mold licensing rules by state](https://moldroster.com/mold-licensing-by-state/)
- [How to hire a mold pro](https://moldroster.com/hiring-a-mold-pro/)
- [All guides](https://moldroster.com/guides/): guides hub plus local hiring guides
- [Get free quotes](https://moldroster.com/quotes/): one request to up to 3 licensed mold pros near a Texas, New York or Washington, DC ZIP (or a chosen pro plus the 2 nearest others); free, no obligation. Florida requests aren't available because DBPR publishes no contact details.

## Listings A–Z
- [Texas listings A–Z](https://moldroster.com/tx/firms/): every TDLR-licensed listing with a profile page
- [Florida listings A–Z](https://moldroster.com/fl/firms/): every FL DBPR-licensed listing with a profile page
- [New York listings A–Z](https://moldroster.com/ny/firms/): every NYS DOL-licensed listing with a profile page
- [Washington, DC listings A–Z](https://moldroster.com/dc/firms/): every DC DOEE-licensed listing with a profile page

## Agent API
- [API catalog](https://moldroster.com/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset
- [OpenAPI spec](https://moldroster.com/openapi.json): search API
- [Feed index](https://moldroster.com/api/index.json): data sources, last-updated date, county/city feeds
- [All firms (JSON)](https://moldroster.com/api/firms.json)
- [MCP server card](https://moldroster.com/.well-known/mcp.json): remote MCP at https://leads.radonroster.com/mcp?site=mold
- [Agent skills](https://moldroster.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json)
